brief.t: START HERE: Call Production and get firm dates for the Roon 500 to 600 unit catch up, the remaining 2,000 units, and material readiness for 10,000 units.

ACT NOW 1: Josh is waiting for the Roon R7 production schedule and the remaining verified process details. He asked October 7 when PLL can produce the 500 to 600 unit catch up, the remaining 2,000 units, and when materials for 10,000 units will be available. No formal deadline is stated; 0 days overdue, but the weekly quantity is at risk. Send: Josh, I am getting Production's confirmed dates for the 500 to 600 unit catch up, remaining 2,000 units, and 10,000 unit material availability, and will send the firm schedule as soon as it is confirmed.

ACT NOW 2: Estogel Max remains a live Roon supply risk. Solabia quoted a 10 to 12 week lead time and is checking whether any of Aidan's intended 20 kg order can ship sooner. Darren promised an availability update today. Aidan and PLL Production are waiting; due today, 0 days overdue. Send: Darren, please confirm today whether any Estogel Max can ship immediately in a split quantity and give the committed availability and dispatch date for the balance. Alert Sam now if no immediate stock is available.

ACT NOW 3: Demurrage for container EMCU8614105 was confirmed cleared after the October 7 cutoff, and dispatchers were notified, but actual pickup is still unconfirmed. PLL is waiting; pickup was due October 7 and is 1 calendar day overdue unless already completed. Send: Vic, demurrage is cleared. Please confirm whether EMCU8614105 was picked up or send the new appointment time.

next: Recommendation: Lock the Roon production dates first, then use Solabia's Estogel confirmation to validate whether those dates are achievable.
Scheduled: 2 confirmed email derived milestones. The nearest is Solabia's Estogel availability update due today; New Directions estimates delivery October 15.
Noise: 25 exact window Outlook messages, none urgent.
Source gaps: CRM browser session signed out. WhatsApp Web signed out. Purchasing and Email did not produce visible replies within the 10 minute collection window. Outlook was scanned directly.
signal: Roon needs a firm catch up and production schedule, Estogel availability may constrain that schedule, and the Polo container pickup remains unconfirmed after demurrage clearance.
redflags: Roon's weekly production quantity is at risk until Production confirms the catch up and remaining run dates.
Estogel Max carries a quoted 10 to 12 week lead time and immediate stock remains unconfirmed; escalate to Sam if no immediate stock is available.
Container EMCU8614105 pickup remains unconfirmed after the October 7 appointment date.
noise: 40 unique inbound Outlook messages arrived in the exact window; 24 were unread and approximately 25 were noise.
